# Aaron Family Livestock — Full Content Index

> Aaron Family Livestock LLC is a registered Angus show cattle and genetics program in Gladewater, Texas, focused on AI sires, embryo calves, foundation females, and family-raised cattle bred for the show ring.

*Generated: 2026-06-01*

---

## Core Documentation

### [Home](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/)
*Overview of Aaron Family Livestock, registered Angus genetics, show record, and contact information.*

Aaron Family Livestock is a registered Angus operation rooted in East Texas. Established in 2005, the program focuses on cattle with the structure, look, and genetic foundation expected by competitive show families.

### [Sires and Genetics](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/#sires)
*Featured AI sires, embryo genetics, donor females, and foundation cow families.*

The program highlights Circle S Moxy 406, El Jefe, Colburn Primo 5153, Silveiras Style 9303, Circle S 5707, and Phat Amy daughter foundation genetics. Aaron Family Livestock works with elite programs such as Circle S Farms to source AI sires and embryo genetics.

### [About](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/#about)
*Family background, Gladewater location, and program philosophy.*

Aaron Family Livestock is a family program in Gladewater, Texas. Every animal receives hands-on attention with the goal of producing cattle that show families trust.

---

## Products & Services

### [AI and Embryo Genetics](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/#sires)
*Registered Angus AI sire and embryo genetics.*

The program includes embryo calves due in 2026 from 5707 x Colburn Primo 5153 and AI genetics tied to proven Angus show cattle lines.

### [Show Cattle Program](https://aaronfamilylivestock.com/#show-record)
*Show record highlights and cattle raised with a family-first approach.*

Show record highlights include San Angelo Stock Show and Rodeo, Cowgirls in Cowtown, and JBBA National achievements.
